contamination_contract.basis: V4 frozen contamination contract, itself derived before historical player outcomes
contamination_contract.diagnostic_unknown_policy: Report diagnostic unknowns; do not silently convert them into same-year identities and do not exclude a league unless positive contamination evidence exists.
contamination_contract.identity_namespace_rule: MFL custom player IDs are league-scoped and must never be treated as globally unique. Custom identities may be matched only with league-scoped metadata plus unambiguous normalized name+position+NFL draft class.
contamination_contract.league_rule: A league with any positive contamination evidence is excluded from every V4 primary/source-sufficiency scope. Diagnostic unknown identities are reported but are not silently converted into same-year identities.
positive_contamination_evidence: Any resolved standard-player identity in the audited draft scope whose NFL draft class is earlier than the league draft year.
Any resolved standard-player identity in the audited draft scope whose NFL draft class is later than the league draft year.
Any league-scoped custom-player identity that unambiguously maps to an earlier or later NFL draft class.
Any league-scoped custom-player metadata explicitly identifying a Devy player/placeholder.

holdout_2024_source_contract.base_eligibility: 12 teams; QB limit 1-2 or 2; Rookie-only draft pool; explicit dynasty or validated missing-keeper proxy; non-mock; complete Rounds 1-4
holdout_2024_source_contract.contamination_rule: Apply the same V4 positive-contamination exclusion contract before freezing the 2024 holdout cohort.
holdout_2024_source_contract.freeze_rule: Freeze every clean eligible league in the complete bounded discovery union; never cherry-pick only the minimum 19.

stable_identity_priority: unambiguous normalized name + frozen draft-era position + draft class

reason: Phase 2 preflight identified that the Phase 1 source reference pointed to the original 213-league V3 primary R1-R4 catalog even though a later pre-outcome audit had already confirmed 41 positively contaminated league drafts. Before any V6 R3/R4 or 2024 outcomes were read, V6 therefore adopts the already-frozen V5 clean full-R4 source lineage: 172 clean V3 seeds plus 206 clean V4 expansion leagues, 378 total.

frozen_clean_development_source.lineage_construction: V3 league_audit rows with positive_rookie_scope_contamination=false and scope.primary_r1_r4=true, plus V4 new_source_evidence rows with positive_contamination=false and primary_r1_r4=true; deduplicate by draft_year + league_id.
phase2_allowed_transport: MFL draftResults for the exact frozen 378 league IDs to rebuild R1-R4 occurrences
MFL players metadata only for identity and contamination verification

superseded_phase1_development_source.description: original V3 primary_r1_r4 catalog including 41 leagues later confirmed contaminated

C1_ROUNDWISE_RESCALE_R1_R4.definition: For rounds 1-4, multiply every deployed tier within round r by k_r. R5-R6 remain exact.
C1_ROUNDWISE_RESCALE_R1_R4.optimizer: exact weighted-LAD linear program using scipy.optimize.linprog(method='highs')
structural_constraints: all 18 cells non-increasing in exact round/tier slot order

C2_ANCHORED_ADDITIVE_ROUND_TIER_CURVE.definition: For R1-R4: value = A - s12*I(round>=2) - s34*max(round-2,0) - tier_penalty[tier], where early penalty=0.
C2_ANCHORED_ADDITIVE_ROUND_TIER_CURVE.optimizer: exact weighted-LAD linear program using scipy.optimize.linprog(method='highs')

C3_SHRUNK_MONOTONE_SLOT_CURVE_R1_R4.alpha_selection: six-class leave-one-draft-year-out H3 O2 macro MAE; among alphas within 1% relative of best choose the largest alpha to favor more shrinkage
C3_SHRUNK_MONOTONE_SLOT_CURVE_R1_R4.definition: Fit C2 on the training classes; compute year-balanced exact-slot H3 O2 means for slots 1-48; shrink each exact-slot mean toward its C2 slot prediction using alpha pseudo-drafts; apply weighted PAVA with a hard lower anchor of 1414 at the R4->R5 boundary; aggregate slots 1-4,5-8,9-12 within each round.
C3_SHRUNK_MONOTONE_SLOT_CURVE_R1_R4.edge_alpha_rule: if selected alpha is 3 or 192, C3 is development-ineligible because shrinkage is not identified inside the preregistered grid

D1_BOUNDARY_FREE_ROUNDWISE_DIAGNOSTIC.definition: Same as C1 but omits only the R4-late >= R5-early boundary. Development diagnostic quantifying the cost of freezing R5-R6. It can never be selected or deployed in V6.

bootstrap.cluster: stable player identity within draft class
bootstrap.quantity: candidate minus C0 LOYO macro MAE

eligibility_gates: LOYO H3 O2 macro MAE improvement vs C0 >= 5%
improve vs C0 in at least 5 of 6 held-out classes
worst held-out class relative MAE regression vs C0 <= 10%
paired player-cluster bootstrap one-sided 95% upper bound for candidate-minus-C0 MAE < 0
H3 O1 normalized-shape error regression vs C0 <= 2%
H2 O2 macro MAE relative regression vs C0 <= 2%
mature H4 O2 macro MAE relative regression vs C0 <= 2%
every development year x cell retention >=95%
every development year x cell identity >=95%
no final numeric parameter at a preregistered hard numeric bound within 1e-6 relative, unless the equality is an explicit structural anchor
development_selection.final_parameter_fit: after family selection, refit selected family once on all 2018-2023 development classes; freeze before any 2024 outcome is opened
development_selection.primary_metric: equal-year equal-cell macro MAE on H3 O2 three_year_player_equivalent_fv
development_selection.winner_rule: lowest LOYO H3 O2 macro MAE among eligible families; candidates within 1% relative MAE of best are resolved by fewer effective fitted degrees of freedom in C1,C2,C3 order

fit_weighting.cell_weight: 12 R1-R4 production cells receive equal macro weight
fit_weighting.draft_class_weight: each 2018-2023 class contributes equal total weight
fit_weighting.league_weight: within class and cell, frozen eligible leagues receive equal total weight
fit_weighting.occurrence_weight: retained occurrences divide their league-cell weight equally
fit_weighting.player_independence: repeated league selections of the same rookie are not independent; inferential resampling clusters by stable player identity within draft class

forbidden: post-V5 repair or overwrite of V5 artifacts
R5-R6 fitting or production changes in V6
KTC/current market values as fit or selection targets
package votes as fit or selection targets
2024 outcome access before V6 final candidate freeze
2026 realized NFL outcomes before future 2024 H3 confirmation stage
manual identity adjudication after V6 outcome access
candidate refit after 2024 holdout is opened

historical_outcome_contract.availability_gate: Every development class must have nonempty H1-H3 season data before fitting. A missing required season excludes the class before fit and forces the six-class feasibility gate to be re-evaluated.

replacement_pool_position_lineage_harden.full_nfl_replacement_pool_position: season-appropriate nflverse roster position mapped by stable player ID; do not classify historical replacement pools from a current 2026 Sleeper position snapshot
replacement_pool_position_lineage_harden.reason: V5 audit found current-position lineage could reclassify historical IDP replacement pools.
